names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Ηλίας ο Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank words left off. The life page adds the patronymic in a parenthesis: «Ο Άγιος Ιερομάρτυς Ηλίας (Νικολάγιεβιτς)». No Russian form of either name is printed on the page, and none is invented here.

death.note: saint.gr heads his page «Άγιος Ηλίας ο Ιερομάρτυρας (; - 1934)». The life itself gives no year for the fire, only the 1932 arrest and a visit two years after it.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026). This is the row that would be expected to carry him, since saint.gr's own account is of a Moscow priest under the Soviet police; it was not read, and no absence is claimed.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).
